title: Tensor calculus and differential geometry
purpose: Manipulate tensors and compute metric, connection and curvature in simple coordinates as preparation for GR.
primary_reading: MIT 18.950 Differential Geometry (use the supplements described in Section 12 for topics beyond the primary source.)

blocks.deliverable: Compute tangent vectors in two charts.
Transform components and distinguish vectors from covectors.
Compute lengths and integrate a simple differential form.
Week 7 midterm; calculate Christoffel symbols for a simple metric.
Derive geodesic equations and interpret a simple solution.
Compare flat coordinates with a curved surface.
Present the calculation and complete a tensor problem examination.

project: Calculate the metric, connection and one curvature quantity on a sphere; explain coordinate dependence.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
